$comment: Drift-detection manifest consumed by NVOOS_SaaS_Controller_Drift_Detector. The build pipeline (Phase 5d, `npm run build:worker`) will populate `expected_sha256` with sha256(worker/dist/index.js) and `expected_etag` with the etag returned from Cloudflare on the most recent deploy. Until then the drift detector reports `status=unknown` (never `drift`), so this addon ships safely without false-positive drift banners.
